name: firebolt-generator
description: Canonical AST generator for Firebolt 9 API headers

scripts.generate: ts-node src/cli.ts generate && cp generated/inject-js/firebolt-inject.d.ts package/firebolt-inject.d.ts && node scripts/minify-webkit-builder.cjs
scripts.generate:webkit-builder: ts-node src/cli.ts generate --targets webkit-builder && node scripts/minify-webkit-builder.cjs
scripts.generate:types: ts-node src/cli.ts generate --targets inject-js-types && cp generated/inject-js/firebolt-inject.d.ts package/firebolt-inject.d.ts
